fact: The Central Bank of Eswatini says it oversees the safety and soundness of national payment systems and lists five licensed payment service providers: MTN Fintech, E-Mali, Instacash, Shoprite mobile Money Services and DeltaPay.

Eswatini Positive News says the Eswatini Payment Switch is a national payment system deployed by the Central Bank of Eswatini to connect banks and mobile wallets, and DeltaPay's transfers now run live on it.
The Central Bank of Eswatini says the Eswatini Payment Switch fast payments platform is fully active, connecting banks and mobile money providers in real time, 24/7.

The article says the Central Bank of Eswatini's Fast Payments system enables transactions across different account types and wallets, and the central bank describes the Eswatini Payment Switch as its payments infrastructure.
The Central Bank of Eswatini has licensed and regulated mobile money operators since 2011, says its Deputy Governor.

Eswatini's Senate considered its Finance Committee report on the proposed National Payment System Regulations, 2026, which would let the Central Bank of Eswatini designate important payment systems and examine payment service providers.
